content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Delhi Urban Art Commission (DUAC), under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India, has released a vacancy circular for the direct recruitment of 2 Group 'C' posts, including 1 Lower Division Clerk and 1 Daftry, both reserved for OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates. The notification includes details regarding vacancies, age limit, educational qualifications, salary, selection process, required documents, and application instructions. Candidates are advised to carefully read the complete notification before applying. The official notification is available through the DUAC website. content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: The official Vacancy Circular does not mention a specific opening date or last date for submission of applications. It only states that the last date/closing date of submission of the application will be counted for determining a candidate's age and experience. Since this detail is not available in the notification, candidates should regularly check the Human Resources - Vacancy section on duac.org.in for the exact application window before it closes.

content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: DUAC has advertised a total of 2 vacancies across two Group 'C' posts. Both posts are reserved for candidates belonging to the OBC (non-creamy layer) category.

content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Lower Division Clerk or Daftry post must satisfy the age and educational qualification criteria specified below. The official notification does not mention any nationality, domicile, or experience requirement beyond what is listed here. Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 25 years Age relaxation for OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates is applicable as per Government instructions. The exact number of relaxation years is not specified in the notification. The last date/closing date of submission of the application will be used to calculate age.

rows.educational_other_qualifications: Essential: (i) Senior Secondary (+2) or an equivalent qualification. (ii) Typing speed of at least 30 words per minute in English or Hindi.
Essential: (i) High School/Matriculation pass. (ii) Ability to read and write English. Desirable: (i) Experience in maintaining records.

content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 - Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Both the Lower Division Clerk and Daftry posts are placed in Level 2 of the Pay Matrix . The exact in-hand or basic pay figure is not mentioned in the official notification. In addition to basic pay, selected candidates will be entitled to: Dearness Allowance (DA) House Rent Allowance (HRA) Medical reimbursement Leave Travel Concession (LTC) These benefits will be governed as per the Delhi Urban Art Commission (Employees Terms and Conditions of Service) Regulations, as amended from time to time. Selected appointees will be covered under the New Pension Scheme (NPS).

content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per the notification, eligible candidates will be screened/shortlisted and called for a written examination . The specific criteria adopted for screening, the exam pattern, and the syllabus are not detailed in this notification and will be displayed only on DUAC's official website, duac.org.in , from time to time.

content_sections.heading: DUAC Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: The notification specifies that candidates must attach the following along with the online application form: Relevant educational certificates OBC (non-creamy layer) certificate Government employees applying for these posts must apply through the proper channel or submit a 'No Objection Certificate' (NOC) from their present employer along with the application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for DUAC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official DUAC website: duac.org.in . Go to the Human Resources - Vacancy section. Click on the application link provided for the Lower Division Clerk or Daftry post. Fill in the online application form carefully with accurate personal and educational details. Upload the relevant educational certificates and the OBC (non-creamy layer) certificate. Government service candidates should also submit an NOC through the proper channel. Review all entered details before final submission, since incorrect or wrong information can lead to cancellation of candidature. Submit the form before the closing date and keep a copy/acknowledgment for future reference.

Persons already in Government service must apply through the proper channel or obtain a No Objection Certificate from their current employer. Withdrawal of the application will not be permitted after applying through this route. The selected candidate will be required to join the post on an immediate basis. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DUAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DUAC has advertised 2 vacancies in total - 1 post of Lower Division Clerk and 1 post of Daftry, both reserved for the OBC (non-creamy layer) category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for DUAC Lower Division Clerk and Daftry posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 25 years, with relaxation applicable for OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates as per Government instructions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for DUAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Lower Division Clerk, candidates need Senior Secondary (+2) with a typing speed of at least 30 words per minute in English or Hindi. For Daftry, candidates need a High School/Matriculation pass with the ability to read and write English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay level for these posts?
faq.answer: Both posts are placed in Level 2 of the Pay Matrix, along with DA, HRA, medical reimbursement, LTC, and coverage under the New Pension Scheme (NPS). The exact salary figure is not mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for DUAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the link provided in the Human Resources - Vacancy section of DUAC's official website, duac.org.in.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for DUAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for DUAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official Vacancy Circular does not specify an application start or last date. Candidates should check DUAC's official website regularly for updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DUAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be screened/shortlisted and called for a written examination. Further details on the exam pattern will be published on the official website.
